arxiv-2207-06346.title: A guideline proposal for minimizing cybersickness in VR-based serious games and applications Thanks:
arxiv-2207-06346.creator: 1 st Thiago Porcino, 2 nd Derek Reilly, 3 rd Esteban Clua, 4 th Daniela Trevisan
arxiv-2207-06346.description: Abstract Head-mounted displays (HMDs) are popular immersive tools in general, not limited to entertainment but also for education, military, and serious games for health. While these displays have strong popularity, they still have user experience issues, triggering possible symptoms of discomfort to users.

arxiv-2311-14921.title: Graph Morphology of Non-Hermitian Bands
arxiv-2311-14921.creator: Yuncheng Xiong, Haiping Hu
arxiv-2311-14921.description: Abstract Non-Hermitian systems exhibit diverse graph patterns of energy spectra under open boundary conditions. Here we present an algebraic framework to comprehensively characterize the spectral geometry and graph topology of non-Bloch bands. Using a locally defined potential function, we unravel the spectral-collapse mechanism from Bloch to non-Bloch bands, delicately placing the spectral graph at the troughs of the potential landscape.

arxiv-2402-04471.title: Reductive Quantum Phase Estimation
arxiv-2402-04471.creator: Nicholas J.C. Papadopoulos, Jarrod T. Reilly, John Drew Wilson, Murray J. Holland
arxiv-2402-04471.description: Abstract Estimating a quantum phase is a necessary task in a wide range of fields of quantum science. To accomplish this task, two well-known methods have been developed in distinct contexts, namely, Ramsey interferometry (RI) in atomic and molecular physics and quantum phase estimation (QPE) in quantum computing.

arxiv-2403-10516.title: FeatUp: A Model-Agnostic Framework for Features at Any Resolution
arxiv-2403-10516.creator: Stephanie Fu, Mark Hamilton, Laura Brandt, Axel Feldmann, Zhoutong Zhang, William T. Freeman
arxiv-2403-10516.description: Abstract Deep features are a cornerstone of computer vision research, capturing image semantics and enabling the community to solve downstream tasks even in the zero- or few-shot regime. However, these features often lack the spatial resolution to directly perform dense prediction tasks like segmentation and depth prediction because models aggressively pool information over large areas.

pmc-10514189.title: M6A regulator methylation patterns and characteristics of immunity in acute ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction
pmc-10514189.creator: Jingqi Yang, Qing Shangguan, Guobo Xie, Ming Yang, Guotai Sheng
pmc-10514189.description: M6A methylation is the most prevalent and abundant RNA modification in mammals. Although there are many studies on the regulatory role of m6A methylation in the immune response, the m6A regulators in the pathogenesis of acute ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) remain unclear.

pmc-10550765.title: Enhanced electrochemical performance of li-ion battery via ultrasonic-assisted inorganic-rich and thin SEI layer
pmc-10550765.creator: Sunghyun Jie, Joonhee Kang, Seunghun Baek, Byeongyong Lee
pmc-10550765.description: Highlights•Ultrasound enhances the electrochemical performances of lithium-ion batteries.•Ultrasound changes the chemical composition of solid electrolyte interface (SEI) to be inorganic-rich.•Ultrasound largely detaches organic species from SEI and thus flattens the surface morphology.•The charge transfer is improved via Ultrasonic-assisted inorganic-rich and thin SEI layer.

pmc-11339161.title: Effects of an Increased Financial Incentive on Follow-up in an Online, Automated Smoking Cessation Trial: A randomized Controlled Study Within a Trial
pmc-11339161.creator: Juliet High, Kelly Grant, Aimie Hope, Lee Shepstone, Claire West, Antony Colles, Felix Naughton
pmc-11339161.description: IntroductionPoor retention in clinical trials can impact on statistical power, reliability, validity, and generalizability of findings and is a particular challenge in smoking cessation studies. In online trials with automated follow-up mechanisms, poor response also increases the resource need for manual follow-up.

pmc-11468373.title: Challenges and recommendations for collecting and quantifying implementation costs in practice: a qualitative interview study
pmc-11468373.creator: Thomasina Donovan, Hannah E Carter, Steven M McPhail, Bridget Abell
pmc-11468373.description: BackgroundThe cost of implementation is typically not accounted for in published economic evaluations, which determine the relative value for money of health innovations and are important for allocating scarce resources. Despite key papers outlining relevant implementation costs, they continue to be under reported in the literature and often not considered in practice.

pmc-11667716.title: Biomechanical Changes to the Ankle After Zadek Osteotomy
pmc-11667716.creator: Nicholas Bellas, Raghunandan Nayak, Mehreen Pasha, Megan R Wolf, Elifho Obopilwe, Thomas McDonald, Lauren E Geaney
pmc-11667716.description: Category:Hindfoot; SportsIntroduction/Purpose:Insertional Achilles tendinopathy is a common source of heel pain in active adults and athletes. This may occur in conjunction with Haglund’s deformity, a calcaneal prominence that can be associated with inflammation of the retrocalcaneal bursa. Corrective surgery may be indicated after failed nonoperative treatment.

pmc-12452443.title: Cost-effectiveness and public health impact of influenza vaccination strategies for Chinese patients with rheumatoid arthritis
pmc-12452443.creator: Kangjun Xu, Zhexin Xu, Yingqi Chen, Chenlu Fan, Chuanxi Fu
pmc-12452443.description: Patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) are at higher risk of influenza than the general population, and influenza vaccination can effectively prevent infection in this group. We assessed the cost‑effectiveness of influenza vaccination for individuals with RA in China. We used a Markov model to project outcomes for several vaccination scenarios in hypothetical Chinese RA cohorts over five years.

pmc-12608877.title: Discovery of Room-Temperature Topological Insulators in Functionalized Group VA-VA Binary Monolayers: A First-Principles Investigation
pmc-12608877.creator: Clement Ding, Xuan Luo, Andres Sotelo
pmc-12608877.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Topological insulators and semimetals are necessary to realize quantum computing and spintronics. We use first-principles calculations to investigate the atomic structure, electronic band structure, and Z2 invariants of four sets of pure and functionalized buckled hexagonal monolayers that are promising candidates for topological nature: BiAs, AsP, SbAs, BiSb, and functionalized monolayers BiAsX2, AsPX2, SbAsX2, and BiSbX2 (X = H, O, S).

pmc-13225015.title: Enhancing the Short Physical Performance Battery: Proposing Norm Values for the 4-Meter Walking Test for Multimorbid Older Adults
pmc-13225015.creator: Berit K Labott, Vera Belkin, Bettina Wollesen, Claudia Voelcker-Rehage
pmc-13225015.description: BackgroundThe Short Physical Performance Battery (SPPB) is a common tool for examining lower extremity physical functioning and respective intervention effects in older adults. It is primarily used in community-dwelling older adults, but also in multimorbid populations such as nursing home residents.

pmc-13426395.title: Stellate Ganglion Block for Post-acute Sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 Infection With Coexisting Post-traumatic Stress Disorder, Anxiety, and Chronic Pain: A Case Report
pmc-13426395.creator: Maanas Chiplunkar, Joseph Kastrenakes, Ruben Dovlatyan, Sidharth Sahni, Michael Flamm
pmc-13426395.description: Post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection (PASC), commonly referred to as long COVID, is characterized by persistent symptoms, including fatigue, cognitive dysfunction, pain, and neuropsychiatric complaints, that can impair daily functioning. Proposed mechanisms are heterogeneous and may include autonomic dysregulation in a subset of patients.

pmc-13614125.creator: Cong Wang, Jichuan Zhang, Jiayu Li, Kaiqi Fan, Shiqi Yin, Yong-Guang Yang, Wenbo Yao, Yuning Zhang, Tianmeng Sun

pmc-13644814.title: The effect of Bartholin gland diseases on female sexual function, sexual distress, and genital self-image: a prospective cohort study
pmc-13644814.creator: Funda Dağıstanlı, Pınar Fatma Yıldız, İhsan Şafak, Mustafa Ayhan Ekici
pmc-13644814.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionBartholin gland disease impairs sexual function, yet most studies focus on surgical technique rather than the broader sexual health burden, and none has systematically examined sexual distress or genital self-image in this population.

pmc-13685163.title: Profiling protein post-translational modifications in plasma-derived extracellular vesicles as fingerprints for breast cancer subtypes
pmc-13685163.creator: Marco Hadisurya, Hillary Andaluz Aguilar, I-Hsuan Chen, Mengting Xu, Juan Sebastian Paez, Rachit Bisht, Jyoti Singh, Zheng-Chi Lee, Amirhesam Mashaollahi, Anton Iliuk, Weizhou Zhang, W. Andy Tao
pmc-13685163.description: BackgroundAddressing tumor heterogeneity in breast cancer research is crucial, given the distinct subtypes like triple-negative, luminal A/B, and HER2, requiring precise differentiation for effective treatment. This study introduces a non-invasive method by analyzing post-translationally modified proteins in plasma extracellular vesicles, which play a role in immune regulation and intercellular communication.
